title: Reinforcement Learning Teachers of Test Time Scaling
authors_zh: Edoardo Cetin, Tianyu Zhao, Yujin Tang
paper_type_zh: 推理数据构建方案与强化学习教师研究
best_for_zh: 设计教师轨迹、学生条件奖励、推理蒸馏或强化学习冷启动流程的研究者
one_line: RLT trains a Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct teacher with dense frozen-student likelihood and explanation-KL feedback to generate raw explanations from known question-solution pairs for downstream distillation.
RLT 以冻结学生的答案似然和解释 KL 反馈训练 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 教师，让其基于已知问题—答案对生成供蒸馏的原始解释，但未发布轨迹数据或明确的教师权重。
why: It makes the teacher-conditioning and feedback contract unusually concrete, while showing that student-specific rewards, answer-conditioned explanations, missing trace releases, and missing teacher weights remain central audit boundaries.
inclusion_reason: A NeurIPS 2025 construction recipe that turns known question-solution pairs into student-conditioned dense rewards for training a small explanation teacher, then uses its raw traces for reasoning distillation and RL cold starts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Correctness-reward reinforcement learning can only reinforce solutions that a starting model sometimes discovers, while reasoning distillation needs explanations that a student can learn from. These objectives are not identical: a model optimized to solve a problem from scratch may produce correct but opaque, idiosyncratic, or poorly transferable traces.

RLT reframes teacher training. Instead of hiding the answer and rewarding one-hot correctness, it gives a small teacher both the question and known solution, asks it to connect them with an explanation, and scores whether a frozen student can recover that solution from the explanation. The relevant atlas object is therefore an answer-conditioned teacher trace and its student-dependent dense feedback contract.

基于正确性的强化学习只能强化初始模型偶尔能探索到的解法，而推理蒸馏需要学生能够学会的解释。这两个目标并不相同：从零解题优化得到的模型，可能输出正确却不透明、风格特殊或难以迁移的轨迹。

RLT 重新定义教师训练。它不隐藏答案并给予一次性正确性奖励，而是把问题与已知答案同时交给小型教师，要求教师用解释连接二者，再判断冻结学生能否借助解释恢复答案。因此，图谱中的核心对象是“答案条件化的教师轨迹”及其“依赖特定学生的密集反馈合同”。 关于《Reinforcement Learning Teachers of Test Time Scaling》：审阅时应把问题边界落在可复用的数据对象与反馈合同，而不是论文标题或榜单分数；输入来源、生成者、输出字段、筛选规则与最终判定器必须分开核对，未公开部分保持为未知。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
A Reinforcement-Learned Teacher starts from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and receives each question together with its known solution. It outputs tagged solution and explanation sections. For downstream SFT, the explanation tokens are extracted into the student's reasoning format and followed by the known solution, yielding a question–reasoning–answer record without extra language-model postprocessing.

The teacher's reward has two student-conditioned components. The first uses the frozen student's mean and minimum log-probability over solution tokens after seeing the explanation. The second uses KL divergence over explanation tokens to penalize logical jumps that are plausible only when the teacher can already see the solution but not from the student's question-only context. A format violation receives -1. GRPO optimizes relative reward within groups; the reward is a learnability proxy, not a formal checker of every reasoning step.

Reinforcement-Learned Teacher 从 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 初始化，并同时接收每道题的问题与已知答案。它输出带标签的答案和解释部分。用于下游 SFT 时，解释令牌被提取为学生的推理格式，后接已知答案，从而形成问题—推理—答案记录，不再经过额外语言模型后处理。

教师奖励包含两个依赖学生的分量。第一项计算冻结学生读完解释后，对答案令牌给出的平均与最小对数概率；第二项在解释令牌上使用 KL 散度，惩罚只有教师看见答案后才显得合理、从学生仅见问题的上下文却构成跳步的内容。格式违规得 -1。GRPO 在组内优化相对奖励；该奖励是可学性代理，不是逐步形式验证器。

title: Method
方法
html:
The main source is Bespoke-Stratos-17k, whose full student-training setting contains 16,710 mathematics and coding question-solution pairs; experiments also use a random 1,000-pair subset. The RLT first receives a short supervised warm-up on example traces reformatted into the answer-conditioned interface. The paper does not publish the warm-up membership as a separate manifest.

Teacher RL runs for 125 GRPO steps with batch size 1,024 and group size 64. Generation uses temperature 0.7, top-p 1.0, no top-k, min-p 0.0, repetition penalty 1.0, and maximum context 16,384. Optimization uses AdamW, constant learning rate, reference-model synchronization every 32 steps, and mixup 0.9; the reported run uses one node with eight H100 GPUs. A frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct supplies the dense reward.

After RL, the teacher recollects explanations for the same question-solution pairs. Distillation generation uses temperature 0.7 and maximum context 32,764. The raw explanations plus known solutions supervise Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct or Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct students. The appendix notes that larger students can suffer from cropped traces and describes collecting up to 16 candidates per pair to find a context-fitting trace. Candidate counts, discarded traces, per-row rewards, selected-trace lineage, and exact 1,000-pair indices are not released.

主要来源是 Bespoke-Stratos-17k；完整学生训练设置包含 16,710 个数学与编码问题—答案对，实验也使用随机 1,000 对子集。RLT 先用按答案条件化接口重排的示例轨迹进行短暂监督热身。论文没有把热身成员作为独立清单发布。

教师强化学习执行 125 个 GRPO 步骤，批量为 1,024，组大小为 64。生成温度 0.7、top-p 1.0、不用 top-k、min-p 0.0、重复惩罚 1.0，最大上下文 16,384。优化使用 AdamW、恒定学习率、每 32 步同步参考模型以及 0.9 mixup；报告的训练在单节点八张 H100 上完成。密集奖励由冻结的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 提供。

强化学习后，教师在相同问题—答案对上重新采集解释。蒸馏生成温度为 0.7，最大上下文为 32,764。原始解释与已知答案用于监督 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 或 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 学生。附录指出大模型学生可能遭遇轨迹截断，并描述为每对最多采集 16 个候选以寻找适配上下文的轨迹。候选数量、丢弃轨迹、逐行奖励、入选轨迹谱系及精确的 1,000 对索引均未发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The reward-ranking study generates 16 explanations per question with the pre-RL teacher, builds 16 rank-specific datasets, and reports a Pearson correlation above 0.89 between reward rank and downstream student performance. This supports the reward as a within-pipeline ranking signal, but does not establish calibration across other students, models, or domains.

On AIME 2024, MATH-500, and GPQA Diamond, the full 16,710-row RLT student reports an overall average of 49.50 at 7B versus 46.60 for the Bespoke baseline; at 32B, the reported averages are 73.23 versus 71.47. These controlled comparisons hold questions and student recipes largely fixed while changing traces. They are downstream outcomes, not direct proof that individual explanations are correct or reusable.

The reward ablation is an important failure test. With the full reward, the 7B overall result is 49.50; removing the explanation-token KL term yields 34.10 and qualitative repetition or excessive length, while removing min/max reductions yields 47.43. The result shows that reward shape materially affects trace behavior. Official artifacts include code and Apache-2.0 distilled 7B/32B students, but no generated-trace dataset or clearly identified RLT teacher checkpoint.

奖励排序研究用强化学习前的教师为每题生成 16 个解释，构建 16 个按名次划分的数据集，并报告奖励名次与下游学生表现之间的 Pearson 相关系数超过 0.89。这支持该奖励作为流水线内部排序信号，却不能证明它在其他学生、模型或领域中已校准。

在 AIME 2024、MATH-500 与 GPQA Diamond 上，完整 16,710 行数据训练的 7B RLT 学生报告总体平均 49.50，Bespoke 基线为 46.60；32B 时分别为 73.23 与 71.47。这类受控比较基本固定问题与学生训练配方，只更换轨迹。它们是下游结果，不是单条解释正确或可复用的直接证明。

奖励消融是重要的失败测试。完整奖励下 7B 总体结果为 49.50；移除解释令牌 KL 项后降至 34.10，并出现重复或过长等定性问题；移除最小/最大归约后为 47.43。这说明奖励形状会实质影响轨迹行为。官方产物包含代码及 Apache-2.0 的 7B/32B 蒸馏学生，但没有生成轨迹数据集或明确标识的 RLT 教师检查点。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper shifts reinforcement learning from “solve without seeing the answer” to “teach effectively with the answer available.” The important distinction is objective alignment: a teacher is rewarded through the intended student's token probabilities rather than only through final-answer correctness. This produces a dense signal even when the small base model cannot discover a hard solution unaided.

Compared with common trace-distillation pipelines, the method trains the generator for downstream learnability and uses its outputs without a separate stylistic postprocessor. It also exposes the answer-conditioned format, two reward components, GRPO settings, and student transfer experiments. The contribution remains a recipe and code release rather than a complete data release because traces, rejected candidates, rewards, and the trained teacher are not published.

论文把强化学习目标从“看不到答案时自行求解”改为“答案已知时有效教学”。关键差异是目标对齐：教师通过目标学生的令牌概率获得奖励，而非只看最终答案是否正确。即使小型基础模型无法独立探索出难题答案，也能获得密集信号。

与常见轨迹蒸馏流水线相比，该方法直接为下游可学性训练生成器，并且不另用风格后处理模型修整输出。它还公开了答案条件化格式、两个奖励分量、GRPO 设置和学生迁移实验。但由于轨迹、拒绝候选、奖励与已训练教师均未发布，这仍是配方与代码发布，而非完整数据发布。 关于《Reinforcement Learning Teachers of Test Time Scaling》：创新性应按可操作的数据变换判断：新增了什么对象、筛选器或反馈合同，以及它与常见蒸馏、拒绝采样或结果验证有何区别。仅扩大样本量或报告更高分数不足以单独证明数据方法创新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The frozen reward student is both a strength and a coupling risk. Explanations can optimize Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct's token probabilities without being equally useful to another student. Solution likelihood and explanation KL do not verify each step, and access to the known answer permits post-hoc rationalization or answer leakage. The ablation shows that a poorly balanced reward can induce repetition and excessive length.

The release lacks the generated explanations, per-example component rewards, malformed or low-ranked outputs, discarded long candidates, exact 1,000-pair indices, teacher checkpoint, run seeds, and row-to-checkpoint lineage. The 7B and 32B Hugging Face models are explicitly distilled students. The mutable repository has no release tag; code should be pinned to an observed revision.

Evaluation uses downstream accuracy as a proxy for trace utility. It does not directly measure step validity, factual error, student-specific overfitting, or explanation faithfulness. Source-to-benchmark decontamination is unreported. Apache-2.0 covers the repository and declared upstream artifacts, but no separately licensed generated-trace release exists. Larger-student cropping and candidate reselection also change the data object in a way that cannot be audited without the missing candidate manifest.

冻结奖励学生既是方法优势，也是耦合风险。解释可以优化 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的令牌概率，却未必同样适合其他学生。答案似然和解释 KL 不验证每个步骤，而教师能看到已知答案，允许事后合理化或答案泄漏。消融还表明，奖励失衡会诱发重复和过长输出。

发布中缺少生成解释、逐样本分量奖励、格式错误或低排名输出、被丢弃的长候选、精确 1,000 对索引、教师检查点、运行种子和行到检查点谱系。Hugging Face 上的 7B 与 32B 模型被官方明确标为蒸馏学生。可变仓库没有 release tag，复现时应固定观察到的提交版本。

评测用下游准确率代理轨迹效用，没有直接测量步骤有效性、事实错误、学生特定过拟合或解释忠实性。来源与基准之间的去污染未报告。Apache-2.0 覆盖代码仓库和声明的上游产物，但不存在单独授权的生成轨迹发布。面向大模型学生的截断与候选重选还会改变数据对象；缺少候选清单时无法审计这一变化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track, RLT is a concrete example of teacher-trace generation whose feedback is defined by the downstream consumer. It helps researchers specify five linked objects: known question-solution seeds, answer-conditioned teacher explanations, frozen-student dense rewards, raw distillation records, and the resulting student checkpoint.

Use the recipe to study student-aware trace rewards, cold-start construction, teacher-size efficiency, reward ablation, and cross-domain trace generation. A responsible reproduction should pin code and upstream revisions, release the trained teacher, record every candidate and reward component, publish exact subsets, test with multiple reward students, audit answer leakage and step validity, document decontamination, and license the generated data. Do not infer trace quality solely from student benchmark gains.

对 Data Construction and Open Release Recipes track，RLT 是“反馈由下游消费者定义”的教师轨迹生成实例。它帮助研究者明确五个相连对象：已知问题—答案种子、答案条件化教师解释、冻结学生密集奖励、原始蒸馏记录和最终学生检查点。

可用该配方研究学生感知轨迹奖励、冷启动构建、教师规模效率、奖励消融与跨领域轨迹生成。负责任的复现应固定代码和上游版本，发布已训练教师，记录每个候选及奖励分量，公布精确子集，以多个奖励学生测试，并审计答案泄漏、步骤有效性与去污染，同时为生成数据明确授权。不可仅凭学生基准提升推断轨迹质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.2–3.3 together: the known solution is teacher input, while the frozen student sees the explanation and is scored on recovering the solution.
  • Keep three models distinct: the trainable 7B teacher, the frozen 7B reward student, and the 7B/32B students later trained on generated traces.
  • Treat the 64 GRPO completions as an online reward group, the 16 candidates as a larger-student cropping workaround, and 16,710 as the full distillation-row count.
  • Use the reward ablation to audit failure modes; removing explanation KL causes repetition and long traces rather than merely a small score change.
  • The official Hugging Face collection contains distilled students. Do not cite it as a release of the teacher or generated trace dataset.

• 合读第 3.2–3.3 节：已知答案是教师输入；冻结学生读取解释后，按恢复该答案的能力得分。
  • 区分三个模型：可训练的 7B 教师、冻结的 7B 奖励学生，以及随后用生成轨迹训练的 7B/32B 学生。
  • 把 64 个 GRPO 补全理解为在线奖励组，把 16 个候选理解为大模型学生的截断规避方案，把 16,710 理解为完整蒸馏行数。
  • 用奖励消融审计失败模式；移除解释 KL 会导致重复和长轨迹，不只是轻微分数变化。
  • 官方 Hugging Face collection 包含蒸馏学生，不能把它引用为教师或生成轨迹数据集的发布。

value.html: A short RLT-format SFT warm-up precedes 125 GRPO steps with batch size 1,024, AdamW, constant learning rate, group size 64, reference-model synchronization every 32 steps, and mixup 0.9. The paper reports one node with eight H100 GPUs. Generated explanations then supervise student SFT.

value_zh.html: 短暂的 RLT 格式 SFT 预热之后是 125 步 GRPO，batch size 1,024、AdamW、恒定学习率、group size 64、每 32 步同步参考模型，以及 mixup 0.9。论文报告一个节点配八块 H100 GPU。生成的解释随后监督学生 SFT。

value.html: The main pipeline uses 16,710 Bespoke-Stratos-17k question-solution pairs and example traces for warm-up, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as both teacher initialization and reward student, and regenerated RLT explanations for distillation. Warm-up membership and generated-trace counts are not published as row-level manifests.

value_zh.html: 主流水线使用 16,710 对 Bespoke-Stratos-17k 问题-解答对与示例轨迹做预热，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 同时作为教师初始化与奖励学生，以及再生的 RLT 解释用于蒸馏。预热成员关系与生成轨迹计数未作为行级清单公布。

value.html: The full 16,710-pair set and a random 1,000-pair subset are reported, but exact subset indices and train-stage lineage are unavailable. Main evaluation uses AIME 2024, MATH-500, and GPQA Diamond; the paper reports no comprehensive overlap audit between upstream training sources and these benchmarks.

value_zh.html: 报告了完整 16,710 对集合与随机 1,000 对子集，但精确子集索引与训练阶段谱系不可得。主评测使用 AIME 2024、MATH-500 与 GPQA Diamond；论文未报告上游训练来源与这些基准之间的全面重叠审计。

items: The reward is computed by one frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct student and can favor explanations specific to that student's token probabilities rather than generally valid pedagogy.
Because the known solution is in the teacher's context, an explanation can rationalize or leak the answer rather than independently derive it.
Higher solution-token likelihood and lower explanation KL do not verify factual correctness of each reasoning step or proof validity.
The paper's ablation shows reward imbalance matters: removing the explanation-token KL term produces repetitive, long traces and much worse downstream results.
Long explanations can be cropped by student context limits; the larger-student workaround uses multiple candidates, but candidate accounting and final per-row choices are unavailable.
No official generated-trace dataset, per-example rewards, rejected traces, exact 1,000-pair indices, or clearly labeled RLT teacher checkpoint was identified.
The official repository has no release tag, so reproduction should pin code revision 86a3f5c78ff20b83cf6dc31d9e6b53003f4c1804 rather than assume mutable master is immutable.
Decontamination and benchmark-overlap controls are not reported.
奖励由一个冻结的 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 学生计算，可能偏向对该学生 token 概率特定的解释，而非普遍有效的教学法。
由于已知解答在教师的上下文中，解释可能合理化或泄漏答案，而非独立推导它。
更高的解答 token 似然与更低的解释 KL 并不核验每一步推理的事实正确性或证明有效性。
论文的消融显示奖励不平衡很重要：移除解释 token KL 项会产生重复、冗长的轨迹以及差得多的下游结果。
长解释可能被学生上下文限制裁切；更大学生的变通使用多个候选，但候选记账与最终逐行选择不可得。
未识别官方生成轨迹数据集、逐样本奖励、被拒绝轨迹、精确 1,000 对索引或明确标注的 RLT 教师 checkpoint。
官方仓库无 release tag，因此复现应钉扎代码修订 86a3f5c78ff20b83cf6dc31d9e6b53003f4c1804，而非假定可变的 master 不可变。
未报告去污染与基准重叠控制。

value.html: The repository is Apache-2.0; the paper reports Apache-2.0 for Bespoke-Stratos-17k and Qwen2.5 models, and the two official distilled-student model cards declare Apache-2.0. No separate generated-trace dataset or generated-trace license was identified.

value_zh.html: 仓库为 Apache-2.0；论文报告 Bespoke-Stratos-17k 与 Qwen2.5 模型为 Apache-2.0，且两份官方蒸馏学生模型卡片声明 Apache-2.0。未识别单独的生成轨迹数据集或生成轨迹许可。

value.html: Bespoke question plus known solution -> RLT-format SFT warm-up -> Qwen2.5-7B GRPO with frozen-student dense reward -> RLT explanation recollection -> explanation plus known solution student SFT -> official 7B and 32B distilled-student checkpoints. Row-level trace, reward, checkpoint, and subset lineage is not released.

value_zh.html: Bespoke 问题加已知解答 -> RLT 格式 SFT 预热 -> 带冻结学生稠密奖励的 Qwen2.5-7B GRPO -> RLT 解释重新收集 -> 解释加已知解答的学生 SFT -> 官方 7B 与 32B 蒸馏学生 checkpoints。行级轨迹、奖励、checkpoint 与子集谱系未发布。
